controlsHere: Kontaroolada laba gacmood waxay si toos ah ugu yaallaan muuqaalka hoostiisa.
rule_basketball5: Tababar garoon buuxa 5 iyo 5. Weerar dambiisha fog: 2 dhibcood gudaha qaansada, 3 dibadda; difaacu wuxuu weeraraa dhinaca kale. Hay K si aad tuuris u xoojiso oo sii daa meel u dhow calaamadda; J waa baasi; Q waa bood; Tab wuxuu beddelaa ciyaaryahanka.
rule_field-hockey: Tababar hoki oo 5 qof koox kasta. Kubbadda ku hay ushaada, baasi ku sii J, oo hoos ugu tuur K gudaha goobada tuurista. Ka soo horjeedayaashu way kaa xadi karaan marka ay kuu dhow yihiin.
rule_water-polo: Tababar barkadda oo 4 qof koox kasta. Ciyaartoydu si gaabis ah ayay u dabaashaan, markaa baasi hore u sii (J) oo goolka yar ku tuur K. Hay foorarsiga si aad cadaadis ugu saarto qofka kubbadda haya.
rule_softball: Tuuris gacan-hoose ah oo laga sameeyo goobo u dhow iyo kubbad ka weyn. U dhaqaaji barta taabashada ulaha xagga kubbadda, hay K oo sii daa marka kubbaddu gaarto saxanka. Garaacyadu waxay keenaan 1–4 dhibcood oo tababar.
rule_beach-volleyball: 2 iyo 2 ciid dushiisa. Gal kubbadda hoosteeda, sii daa K si aad shabagga uga dul weerarto, ama J si aad si jilicsan kor ugu tuurto. Dhibic ayaa la helaa marka kubbaddu taabato ciidda dhinaca kale.
rule_golf: Ku beegso barta midig, hay K si aad xoogga u dejiso, sii daa si aad u luliso. Garaacyo yar oo godka lagu gaaro ayaa dhibco badan leh; hal garaac godka waa 10 dhibcood. Dabaysha waxaa lagu muujiyaa shaashadda.
rule_cricket: Kubbadda tuuraha (bowler) hal mar ayay dhulka ku boodaa ka hor inta aysan ku soo gaarin. Ulaha u dhaqaaji xariiqda kubbadda, hay K oo sii daa xariiqda garaacista (crease). Orodyada waxaa go'aamisa masaafada, 4 xadka, 6 xadhigga dushiisa; haddii aad kubbadda seegto oo ay ku dhacdo tiirarka (stumps), waad baxday (bowled).
rule_sepak-takraw: Kubbadda laliska lugta oo 3 iyo 3 ah. Gal kubbadda hoosteeda oo sii daa K si aad shabagga uga dul laaddo, ama J si aad si xakameysan kor ugu qaado. Kubbaddu ma taaban karto dhulka dhinacaaga.
rule_squash: Kubbadda ku dhufo derbiga hore oo ka sarreeya birta hoose (tin). Ku celi ka hor boodka labaad; ka soo horjeeduhu sidaas oo kale ayuu sameeyaa. Isweydaarsi kasta wuxuu ku dhammaadaa dhibic.
rule_lacrosse: Tababar ul oo 5 qof koox kasta. Kubbadda shabagga ulaha ku hay, baasi ku sii J oo ku tuur K goolka yar ee shabagga leh. Difaacayaashu way garaaci karaan ulaha qofka kubbadda haya.
rule_bowling: Ku beegso barta midig, hay K si aad xawaaraha u dejiso oo sii daa. Biinanka la dumiyo ayaa dhibco ah; istaraayig waa dhammaan tobanka. Wareejinta waxaa lagu sameeyaa barta bidix.
rule_soft-tennis: 2 iyo 2 kubbad caag jilicsan ah oo kor iyo gaabis u boodda. Sii daa K si aad toos u garaacdo, J si aad kor ugu tuurto. Hal bood ka hor celin kasta.
rule_billiards: Ku beegso barta midig, hay K si aad xoog u urursato oo sii daa si aad u garaacdo kubbadda cad. Kubbadaha kale godadka geli si aad dhibco u hesho; haddii kubbadda cad godka gasho waa khalad (scratch).
rule_flag-football: Kubbadda cagta oo aan taabasho jireed lahayn, 5 qof koox kasta. Orod ama baasi (J) u sii xagga aagga dhammaadka; haddii difaacuhu calankaaga kaa jiido ciyaartu way istaagtaa. 6 dhibcood oo tababar touchdown kasta.
